title: c32 takes Q:bd-rtwo56-dog-twin: r-two56 with every ring kernel replaced by the Gaussian heat kernel of the same mass and second moment (a Laplacian-generated twin), 3 seeds from noise against the original
summary: Matched Laplacian-only twin for r-two56's shelled cogs: U = exp(tau lap) A with tau = <r^2>/4 per kernel, same growth functions, same noise; compare labkit radial shell scores and images on seeds 0-2.
